decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the product feed specifically for general-purpose or outdoor backpacks, filtering out the miscategorized paddle boards and accessory items. My consideration set included a variety of tactical packs, a technical hiking pack with a frame, a lightweight packable rucksack, and a hydration-focused pack. I selected the Warriors Product Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_064) as my final choice because it has a perfect 5.0 rating across its reviews, specifically emphasizing durability and quality. At $31.99, it offers superior value compared to the more expensive USWE or Kailas options, while appearing more robust than the lightweight packable ZOMAKE bag.
